entities.summary: Dhofar Liberation Front was a revolutionary organization that operated in the Dhofar Governorate of Oman from 1965 to 1968. Established on 26 December 1964 following the merger of the Dhufari Soldiers' Organization and the Dhofar Benevolent Society, its main aims were to end the rule of Sultan Said bin Taimur, and to end British imperial influence in the region. The front initiated the Dhofar Rebellion in June 1965.
